note: Lorecast sites (docs/AOTL_CAMPAIGN_ZONES.md, Lorecasting): the remains or echo of a figure of the Gilded Epoch. Walking onto the site wakes its echo; defeating the echo teaches its skill to any class.

lore: The armour is Concord-forged, untouched by rust after an age in the dark.
As you kneel, light gathers into a man in that armour: Aurelian Dace, Exalted of the Radiant Order. He does not know the Concord has fallen. He knows only that you are not one of his.
He has fallen to you, and in falling he understands. The last of his light is yours: the Radiant Spear.
